Pricing

Know the cost before you tap

This is our planned pricing. Final fees, limits and eligibility will be in the account agreement before any account opens.3

Planned core banking fees
ServicePlanned cost
Monthly maintenance$0Our goal for core checking and savings.
Standard ACH transferFreeTo and from your linked outside accounts.
Instant transfer (optional)Fee appliesThe fee, speed and limit are shown before you confirm.5
TANDA-to-TANDA paymentFreeTo other eligible TANDA members. Limits apply.
ATM withdrawal, in networkFreeAt participating in-network ATMs. Network to be announced.4
ATM withdrawal, out of networkFees may applyThe ATM owner may also charge a fee.
TANDA Spot overdraft coverage$0No fee or interest on covered amounts, up to $50, for eligible customers.6
Savings Backup transfer$0Optional. Only if you turn it on.7

Optional membership

TANDA+

$7.99 / month

We plan to waive the fee in any month your qualifying direct deposits total $1,000 or more.8

  • Enhanced Rewards offers from local and national merchants
  • Advanced spending and savings insights
  • Extra financial and lifestyle perks

Benefits, waiver rules and billing terms are not final. Support, security, accessibility and core banking never require TANDA+.

TANDA Rewards

Offers from the businesses around you

Every customer will get access to basic merchant offers, from Latino-owned neighborhood businesses to national retailers. TANDA+ members get enhanced offers. We'll share specific offers once partners sign on.9
